stepExplanation:
Taking the initial direction of the ball as positive:
$$F\Delta t = m(v_f - v_i)$$
$$F(0.02) = 0.15((-40) - 30)$$
$$F(0.02) = 0.15(-70)$$
$$F(0.02) = -10.5$$
$$F = -525 \text{ N}$$
The magnitude is 525 N. The negative sign indicates the force is opposite to the ball's initial direction.
stepBody: Using FΔt = m(v_f - v_i) with m = 0.15 kg, v_i = +30 m/s, v_f = -40 m/s, and Δt = 0.02 s, calculate the magnitude of the average force. Give your answer in N.
